subject: general
question: ________ five year plan of Government of India (2012-17) was India's last Five Year Plan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Twelfth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Twelfth Five Year Plan **of the Government of India covered the period from **2012-2017**.
 
• The Twelfth Five Year Plan aimed to achieve** faster, sustainable, and more inclusive growth.**
 
• It focused on **reducing poverty **and improving the **standard of living** of the people.
 
• The Twelfth Five Year Plan also aimed to improve** infrastructure**, increase** investment in agriculture**, and promote **social inclusion.**
 
• It emphasized the need to address** environmental concerns** and** improve governance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eighth Five Year Plan** covered the period from **1992-1997.**
 
• **Fifth Five Year Plan** covered the period from **1974-1978.**
 
• **Tenth Five Year Plan** covered the period from **2002-2007. **
